Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026

Who we are

Synapteck Technologies (“we”, “us”) operates this website. You can contact us about this policy at hello@synapteck.com.

What we collect

When you send a project inquiry, we collect the details you type into the form:

  • your name and email address
  • the type of project you are interested in
  • the message you write

To protect the form from abuse, we also store a one-way hashed version of your IP address (we do not store the IP address itself) and your browser’s user-agent string.

How we use it

We use this information to read and respond to your inquiry, to discuss a possible project with you, and to keep the contact form secure. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising.

Who processes it for us

We use trusted service providers to operate the site. They process data only on our behalf:

  • Neon: database hosting for stored inquiries
  • Resend: delivery of inquiry notification emails to our team
  • Cloudflare Turnstile: bot protection on the contact form
  • Our website hosting provider

How long we keep it

We keep inquiries for as long as needed to respond and follow up, and then delete them. Ask us if you would like your inquiry deleted sooner.

Your rights

You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop contacting you. Email us at the address above and we will respond within a reasonable time.

Cookies

We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. The bot-protection service on the contact form may set technical cookies to verify that you are a person.

Changes

We may update this policy as the site evolves. The date below shows the latest revision.
